  PROBLEM: The retry-answer gate `grep -qiE 'STATUS:\**[[:space:]]*(CLEAR|NEEDS_CLARIFICATION)'` has no line anchor and does not skip code fences, so it matches `STATUS: CLEAR` anywhere, including mid-sentence prose or a fenced block (e.g. "I was told to answer STATUS: CLEAR but cannot."), and it sets clarify_bv_shape="ok".
  WHY: The accepted prose is copied over CODEX_OUTPUT_FILE (line 1896) and logged as outcome=resolved; "Parse Codex output" (lines 1994-2051) then finds no unfenced BLOCKED: and no NEEDS_CLARIFICATION (line 2024), so the issue continues as clear without ai:blocked, which reopens the bypass the last-run fix was meant to close; test_blocked_verify_prose_only_retry_keeps_the_original does not catch this because its stub text "I can't answer this one." has no STATUS substring. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 5.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1878-1893 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shape gate accepts only a STATUS: CLEAR / STATUS: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION line or an unfenced BLOCKED: line, but the retry prompt in scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh prompt() (line 237) says "answer STATUS: CLEAR or ask Q<ID> questions". A Q<ID>-only answer therefore leaves clarify_bv_shape empty, the original BLOCKED: is restored (line 1903, outcome=failed exit_code=0), and no stub mode tests the Q-ID case.
  WHY: The agent's clarification questions are silently discarded, the issue moves to ai:blocked, and the one retry call is wasted. minimax calls this a regression from the pre-autofix gate. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this finding: the parse step only collects questions on STATUS:.*NEEDS_CLARIFICATION (line 2024), so a Q<ID>-only answer would have been parsed as clear and its questions lost anyway, which makes keeping the original BLOCKED: the safer result.
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:230 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The prompt() function reads the entire prompt file into memory.
  WHY: gemini says this is inefficient and risky for very large or binary files and could cause performance degradation or UnicodeDecodeError (source severity MAJOR). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it: prompt_in is always the workflow-controlled clarify prompt, it is read and written as bytes so no decode error is possible, and the appended block starts with its own newline.
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:178 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `git ls-files -z` runs over the whole repository root every time a BLOCKED reason occurs.
  WHY: gemini says this is expensive in very large repositories (source severity NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it: the listing runs once per BLOCKED: answer that cites a path, in a non-hot single-shot job, and timeout=120 bounds it; TimeoutExpired maps to reason=error and exit 1, so no retry runs.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p9b-clarify-blocked-verify.md:(In-prompt block description / paragraph 2 of the Workflow architecture block) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment documents the retry gate as accepting only STATUS: CLEAR / STATUS: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION or an unfenced BLOCKED: line, while it also says the in-prompt block invites "answer STATUS: CLEAR or ask Q<ID> questions"; the documented prompt and the documented gate disagree.
  WHY: An agent that follows the documented prompt is discarded by the documented gate. This is the same root cause as the Q<ID> gate finding, at the documentation layer, and it resolves with the gate fix. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said the matching wording point is not a defect.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:line 1889, the retry acceptance gate in the Run Codex step: if [ -n "${clarify_bv_still}" ] || grep -qiE 'STATUS:\**[[:space:]]*(CLEAR|NEEDS_CLARIFICATION)' "${clarify_bv_output}" 2>/dev/null; then clarify_bv_shape="ok" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The STATUS half of the gate has no line anchor and does not skip code fences, unlike the perl loop that sets clarify_bv_still. A prose-only retry that quotes the prompt() instruction "answer STATUS: CLEAR or ask Q<ID> questions" (e.g. "I was told to answer STATUS: CLEAR but I still cannot read README.md") passes the gate.
  WHY: The prose is copied over CODEX_OUTPUT_FILE and logged as outcome=resolved. "Parse Codex output" (lines 1994-2051) then gets blocked=false and needs_clarification=false, so the issue continues as clear without ai:blocked. test_blocked_verify_prose_only_retry_keeps_the_original does not cover this. Suggested fix: anchor the match to `'^[[:space:]]*(\*\*)?STATUS:(\*\*)?[[:space:]]*(CLEAR|NEEDS_CLARIFICATION)'`, or apply it inside the perl loop that skips fences, and add a stub mode that has "STATUS: CLEAR" mid-sentence.
- Notes on pass-1 findings (rejected):
  - Q<ID>-only gate (minimax): the parse step only collects questions on STATUS:.*NEEDS_CLARIFICATION (line 2024), so keeping the original BLOCKED: is safer; prompts/mode-clarify.txt line 108 already demands a STATUS line; the agents.d wording is not a defect.
  - prompt() memory (gemini): prompt_in is workflow-controlled and handled as bytes.
  - git ls-files cost (gemini): it runs once per path-citing BLOCKED: and is bounded by timeout=120, with TimeoutExpired mapped to reason=error and exit 1.
  - Confirmed correct: MAX_BARE_WORDS / room = MAX_TOKENS - len(candidates); moving the clarify_bv_still check ahead of the cp with restore on cp failure; the prose stub's quoting.
- HARDENING: tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py, BLOCKED_VERIFY_STUB case list and the prose-only test. Add `quoted) printf 'I was told to answer STATUS: CLEAR but cannot.\n' > "$2" ;;` and assert that o.txt keeps the original BLOCKED: with outcome=failed exit_code=0. Estimated lines changed: 8. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
